verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party docs say apps can subscribe to webhook topics to receive near-real-time event data. The same docs position webhooks for keeping apps in sync and for triggering follow-up actions, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: details on the topic catalog, delivery and retry semantics, and signature verification; subscription management via API/CLI; agent-specific webhook guidance; independent or hands-on corroboration.
